docs.note: Census Data API User Guide page (PDF guide, last revised May 2026) plus a Discovery Tool and a dataset catalog at api.census.gov/data.html.

api.note: Public Census Data API, TIGERweb REST and Geocoder REST services; read-only statistical data, not property records.

pricing.note: The user guide says the API key is free of charge; no paid plans.

changelog.note: Developer Updates page; newest entry listed is February 2022. Dataset release dates are on the Available APIs page.

items.excerpt: The Census Bureau's API allows developers to design web and mobile apps to explore or learn more about America's changing population and economy.
An API key must be used with all data queries made to the Census Data API.
items.note: Guide text read from the public PDF.

items.excerpt: You can register for an API key, free of charge, by following these steps
items.note: Key arrives by email; one key type with no scopes.

items.excerpt: You can include up to 50 variables in a single API query.

items.note: CSV output is also described in the guide.

items.excerpt: The Census Data Application Programming Interface (API) is an API that gives the public access to raw statistical data from various Census Bureau data programs.
TIGERweb GeoServices REST API provides Census area boundaries/shapes referenced by FIPS codes.
items.note: Geocoder REST service translates addresses to lat/lon; boundaries only, no parcels.

items.excerpt: Therefore, users will not use these data, alone or in combination with any other Census or non-Census data, to identify any individual person, household, business
items.note: Terms bar identifying individuals or businesses; the data has no owner names or sale prices.
